subject.title: skill_workshop: quarantined proposals are CLI dead-ends (no apply/revise/reject path back)

question: Which recovery transition should Skill Workshop support for quarantined proposals, if any?
rationale: Current shipped docs and tests intentionally make non-pending proposals terminal, and changing quarantined recovery affects safety semantics plus public CLI, Gateway, agent-tool, and UI behavior.

options.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
options.body: Support a bounded recovery path such as reject/dismiss from quarantined plus revise-to-pending only after a fresh clean scan and explicit audit metadata.

options.title: Align with restore semantics
options.body: Wait for the rejected-restore API direction to settle, then extend the same public recovery model to quarantined proposals if maintainers want one verb.

options.title: Keep quarantine terminal
options.body: Document that quarantined proposals are immutable safety holds and users must create clean replacement proposals instead.

recommendation.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
recommendation.body: Support a bounded recovery path such as reject/dismiss from quarantined plus revise-to-pending only after a fresh clean scan and explicit audit metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Skill Workshop lifecycle work makes this the strongest available routing signal for the product/API choice.
